objectClass.primaryType: low-poly memorial statue on architectural pedestal
objectClass.notes: Full-body stylized adult woman holding a closed book against her left torso. Four orthographic-like views are available. Target is a readable low-poly sculpture, not an exact face copy.

reasoning: The silhouette combines a 6.3-head stylized human, long fitted coat, floor-length skirt, long layered hair, asymmetrical bent book arm, relaxed right arm, and a pedestal occupying roughly 27 percent of total height.
Faceted planes are identity-defining and must come from low-segment geometry with flat normals, not a smooth primitive stack.
The four views reduce occlusion uncertainty for hair, coat split, book depth, arm pose, and pedestal profile.

specDepthDecision.rationale: Character anatomy, conforming garments, layered hair and architectural pedestal require separate semantic components even though the prop remains static.

unknownsToResolveBeforeImplementation: Exact facial identity is not recoverable from the 384px frontal crop; preserve mature angular expression and landmark placement rather than claiming portrait likeness.
Book cover ornament and pedestal inscription are not visible and will remain unadorned.
Fine fabric and stone variation will be procedural and approximate.

detailInventory.note: Enumerate every identity-defining small detail before authoring the spec. Each detail must map to a component.localFeatures entry or material.localOverrides entry, never prose only. Use forge/stage1_intake/build_detail_inventory.py to scan zones.

pose.type: upright near-symmetric stance with asymmetrical book arm

features: center-parted long hair terminating below shoulder blades
long narrow face with pronounced cheek and jaw planes
long split-front coat over floor-length skirt
anatomy.note: Measured from the isolated frontal figure and cross-checked against right, back and left views. Head-unit excludes the pedestal.

definitionOfDone: At Hall close-up the model reads immediately as the referenced Roxana statue: a 6.3-head adult woman with long center-parted hair, angular mature face, pointed period coat, bow tie, book held to the left chest, relaxed right arm, floor-length skirt, and stepped carved-stone pedestal.
Front, right profile, back and three-quarter renders retain consistent depth and do not collapse into cards or disconnected primitive stacks.
Flat-shaded triangulated planes create the low-poly carved-stone response while maintaining continuous anatomy and garment contact.

featureGroups.name: 6.3-head anatomy, upright stance and asymmetrical arm silhouette
qualityCriteria: Head, shoulders, waist, coat hem, skirt hem and pedestal preserve the measured vertical ratios.
The left elbow bends across the torso around the book while the right arm hangs close to the coat.
failureModes: figure reads as chibi, mannequin-like or capsule-built
book arm and relaxed arm become symmetric
pedestal overwhelms or miniaturizes the figure

featureGroups.name: Angular mature face and long center-parted faceted hair
qualityCriteria: Face uses measured landmarks, tapered jaw, nose bridge, brow and mouth planes rather than a featureless sphere.
Hair forms 8-14 large connected clumps around the face and down the back, with a visible center part.
failureModes: head reads as a ball or mask
hair reads as a helmet, loose cylinders or disconnected strands

featureGroups.name: Period coat, lapels, bow, waistcoat, skirt and held book
qualityCriteria: Coat is a conforming shell with long split front and back panels over a separate skirt volume.
Pointed lapels, bow tie and button row remain legible at the Hall close-up distance.
Book intersects neither torso nor hand and is visibly supported by forearm and fingers.
failureModes: book floats or clips through the torso

featureGroups.name: Stepped architectural pedestal with recessed framed plaque
qualityCriteria: Pedestal contains foot, lower steps, rectangular shaft, framed recessed plaque, cornice and statue cap as distinct beveled levels.
Plaque border and step shadows remain visible without introducing unreadable text.
failureModes: pedestal reads as a single cube
plaque is painted rather than recessed
step proportions disagree between front and profile

featureGroups.name: Warm faceted carved-stone material and readable planar lighting
qualityCriteria: One coherent warm limestone family uses subtle light/dark regional variation and high roughness.
Flat normals and controlled triangulation create visible planes on face, hair, sleeves, coat and skirt.
Key, fill and rim lighting explain the planes without metallic or plastic highlights.
failureModes: surface reads as bronze, plastic or smooth clay
faceting is random noise that damages the silhouette
lighting flattens facial and garment planes

visualDeltaChecks: local feature placement and scale delta
antiShallowSpecRules: Do not proceed to code if qualityContract.qualityBar is unassessed.
Do not proceed to code if the spec only contains a root component for a moderate or complex object.
Do not proceed to code if required featureGroups are not represented by componentTree, materials, or repetitionSystems.
Do not proceed to code if visible local features are described only in prose and not attached to components/materials/evidenceRefs.
Do not proceed past structural-pass if attached child parts lack attachment.parentSocket, localStart, localEnd, embedDepth/overlap, and gapTolerance.
Do not pass material look-dev when albedo is reused as roughness, height, normal, or AO.
Do not pass material look-dev without macro, meso, and micro surface frequency bands for close-up materials.
Do not pass reference-fidelity material look-dev from a source image without usable referencePbr maps or an explicit documented limitation.
Do not patch a spec with extracted PBR maps when extraction confidence is below the target threshold unless the user explicitly accepts lower fidelity.

authoringInstruction: Fill observed object class, complexity reasoning, featureGroups, visualDeltaChecks, and unknowns before generating or implementing ObjectSculptSpec.
